items.title: Russia Warns U.K. Over G20 Presidency After London Says Putin Won't Come to Its Summit
items.description: Russia remains a member of the G20 despite Western efforts to isolate it over its war in Ukraine.

items.title: Landmark Crimea bridge hit as Russia reports biggest Ukrainian drone attack of war
items.description: Russia said Ukraine had launched over 2,000 drones over the course of a day, while Kyiv came under a record 17 air raid alerts.

items.title: After Ukraine hits key Crimea bridge in 1,300-drone overnight barrage, Russia strikes Kyiv
items.description: Russian strikes hit two major bridges in Kyiv late Monday, shortly after Ukraine's air force warned of incoming missiles. Ukraine earlier struck a bridge linking annexed Crimea to Russia, disrupting traffic on the key passageway, then hitting it a second day in a row.

items.title: ASEAN offers Myanmar's sidelined leaders a path back to summits, but says restrictions will stay until there is meaningful progress on its peace plan
items.description: Southeast Asian leaders have agreed to engage Myanmar in stages after years of excluding its leaders from high-level meetings. The bloc says Myanmar could regain full representation if it makes progress on a peace plan.

items.title: First Person: Managing risk on Ukraine’s frontline
items.description: Humanitarian workers providing support to communities on the frontline of the war between Ukraine and Russia must balance remaining close to those in need with the heightened risks of operating in a conflict zone, according to the top UN official in Ukraine.

items.title: Bahrain Says It Intercepted Iranian Attacks As Tehran Claims Strike On US Base
items.description: Bahrain said its air defenses intercepted and destroyed several Iranian aerial attacks on November 15, after explosions and air raid sirens were reported across the Gulf kingdom and Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed it had targeted a US military installation.
